SELECT 'CARD' objectType,k.id,k.knowledge_code objectCode,k.title,k.type, k.summary,k.content,k.status,k.confidence,k.created_time createdTime,k.updated_time updatedTime FROM t_knowledge_card k WHERE #{objectType}='CARD' AND k.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND k.knowledge_code=#{objectCode} AND (k.permission_tags IS NULL OR JSON_LENGTH(k.permission_tags)=0
OR (JSON_CONTAINS(k.permission_tags, JSON_QUOTE(#{tag}))) ) UNION ALL SELECT 'CLAIM',c.id,c.claim_code,c.subject,c.predicate, NULL,c.object_value,c.status,c.confidence,c.created_time,c.updated_time FROM t_claim c WHERE #{objectType}='CLAIM' AND c.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND c.claim_code=#{objectCode} AND (c.permission_tags IS NULL OR JSON_LENGTH(c.permission_tags)=0
OR (JSON_CONTAINS(c.permission_tags, JSON_QUOTE(#{tag}))) )

SELECT id,object_type objectType,object_code objectCode,version_no versionNo,title,summary,content,status,confidence, change_type changeType,changed_by changedBy,supersedes_version_no supersedesVersionNo,created_time createdTime FROM t_knowledge_version WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND object_type=#{objectType} AND object_code=#{objectCode} ORDER BY version_no DESC
